ownership_summary: Owned by First Avenue Entertainment LLLP, a partnership of about 18 individual partners led by chairman and managing partner John Stanton, who took control in August 2016 when Nintendo of America sold all but 10% of its stake; Nintendo keeps 10%. Ken Griffey Jr. (2021) and Brad Smith and Kathy Surace-Smith (2024) bought in since. No private equity or other fund holder is on record.
